basic_info.description: Price reduced by $50K! Welcome to this inviting 2-bedroom, 1-bath condo located in the desirable Mt. Davidson Manor along vibrant Ocean Ave. Designed for both comfort and convenience, this home features an open-concept kitchen, dining, and living area, perfect for seamless entertaining. Enjoy the new stainless- steel appliances, partial wood flooring, fresh interior paint and the ease of in-unit laundry. Additional highlights include secure intercom entry, a deeded gated parking space with designated storage and elevator access to the unit. Ideally situated just steps from local shops, cafes, restaurants, library, yoga studio and transit options including K-Street Muni Metro, multiple bus lines and Balboa BART station. Enjoy quick access to Highways 1 & 280 as well as nearby parks and playgrounds for outdoor recreation. Close to 24 Hour Fitness, SFSU, CCSF, Whole Foods & Stonestown Galleria. A perfect blend of modern elegance and urban convenience, don't miss this fantastic opportunity! The unit is being destaged.
